releases.title: Production configuration safeguards
releases.summary: Finance-owner access is protected and production deployments fail fast on unsafe environment settings.
changes: Role changes are validated against supported account roles; only the platform administrator can grant finance-owner access.
Production startup requires a strong, unique signing secret and administrator password, explicit HTTPS CORS origins, and TLS for MongoDB.
internals: Added regression coverage for role escalation and production configuration validation.

releases.title: Live data consistency
releases.summary: Deleted data now disappears immediately and project entry controls are production-ready.
changes: Party deletion permanently removes the party, its portal user and party documents.
App data is cache-first, invalidates instantly after writes, and revalidates on focus and every 30 seconds.
Replaced the clipped date picker with a clear calendar button beside the formatted date field.
internals: Core delete endpoints now physically remove selected MongoDB records while retaining audit events.

releases.title: Predictable party login IDs
releases.summary: New party and user IDs are now generated from the last name with safe collision handling.
changes: Default login IDs use lastname@nivara.com, then lastname1@nivara.com, lastname2@nivara.com when required.
The Add User form now suggests the default ID and last-name password while the server guarantees the final available ID.
internals: Creation endpoints no longer require a manually entered email when a name is available.

releases.title: Private party operations
releases.summary: Project payments, party credentials and navigation are now faster and more accountable.
changes: Project expenses now support saved accounts, Cash, UPI details and party payment acknowledgement.
Every project party receives an isolated login, with a dedicated portal for its own payments and documents.
Added an in-app party creation flow, Indian amount entry, a date picker alongside settings-formatted date entry, and collapsible navigation groups.
internals: Party document access is enforced server-side and initial passwords are never retained after a reset.
Updated shared UI controls with focused transition properties and accessible collapsible navigation states.

releases.title: Wealth command center
releases.summary: A complete premium UI/UX redesign for the financial workspace.
changes: Redesigned the shared application shell, visual system, responsive workspace and dense financial surfaces.
Rebuilt the overview around a large net-worth canvas, allocation drill-downs, cash position and interactive financial detail drawers.
Added command-style global search with Ctrl/Cmd + K keyboard access and richer investment table interactions.
internals: Introduced reusable drawer, skeleton-loading and compact sticky-table primitives for consistent interaction across modules.
Updated live header identity to use the browser's actual local timezone.

releases.title: Unified financial data foundation
releases.summary: Traceable, review-first import and canonical financial records.
changes: Added Import Center review with document hashing, provider detection, confidence explanations, duplicate detection and bulk approval.
Imported holdings now consolidate existing positions while historical P&L is kept distinct from current holdings.
Added recorded net-worth history, liability allocation, cash position and cross-module financial search.
internals: Introduced canonical financial entities, holdings, financial transactions, import runs, import rows and valuation snapshots with additive indexes.
Import commits use MongoDB transactions on replica-set deployments and remain idempotent through stable fingerprints otherwise.

releases.title: Household operating system
releases.summary: Action-led planning, review workflow and cash-risk controls.
changes: Action Center can record source-linked payments, mark items reviewed, resolve them, or postpone them.
Unified Review Inbox brings transactions and financial commitments into one searchable needs-review queue.
Cash outlook identifies the exact lowest projected balance and dates when cash can become tight.
Ownership rollups now include individual, family, farm/business and consolidated views.
Health check adds debt-to-income, EMI-risk, tax-document and scheduled contribution signals.
Financial Snapshot exports a self-attested workbook with ownership, commitments and linked-document index.
Added retirement, rental-yield, SIP step-up and lending-recovery calculators.
internals: Server-side numeric validation rejects non-finite, negative and out-of-range percentage values.
Version history is exposed through a stable API for future release automation.

releases.title: Planner foundations
releases.summary: Calendar commitments, records and ownership foundation.
changes: 30-day commitments and past-due action awareness.
Recurring rent and farm lease collection support.
Document vault categories and baseline planning calculators.
internals: Improved operational error logging and cache invalidation after writes.
